name: Aristocrat Leisure Limited
summary: Aristocrat Leisure Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an entertainment and gaming content creation company in Australia and internationally. It operates through three segments: Aristocrat Gaming, Product Madness, and Aristocrat Interactive. The company designs, develops, assembles, distributes, sells, and services gaming content, platforms, and systems, including electronic gaming machines, casino management systems, and iLottery and free-to-play mobile games. It also engages in regulated land-based gaming, social casino, and regulated online real money gaming businesses. Aristocrat Leisure Limited was founded in 1950 and is based in North Ryde, Australia.
